title: Unit 7 review: race, class and power
goal: I can use the grammar and words of this unit to talk about race, class and power in the colonial world.

items: I can explain how people were classified in colonial cities and what changed under the Bourbon reforms.
I can describe the position of indigenous and Afro-descendant people in the 18th century.
I can explain how mixing and inequality existed together.
I can say what changed and what stayed the same after independence.
